* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), slip 110E: “Dark Side game text on your non-docking bay Yavin 4 sites is canceled. During your deploy phase, may place this character in Used Pile to ▲ one Advance Preparation or Death Star: Trench.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 8, slip 110E.
